bug_description: order list page keeps loading forever when the connection drops.
screenshot_description: Page showing an endless spinner over the order list.
console_logs:
Uncaught (in promise) Error: Network Error
    at loadData (auth.js:80:4)
steps_to_reproduce: Open https://app.acme-saas.io/account → Disable the network in DevTools and reload → Wait 30 seconds → Observe the spinner never stops

steps_to_reproduce: Log in → Click 'Log out' → Replay a request with the old session cookie or press Back on https://admin.fleetly.dev/logout → Observe private data is still returned

resolution: Invalidate the session/token on the server at logout and send no-store cache headers.

steps_to_reproduce: Create a subscription on Aug 31 → Open https://app.acme-saas.io/billing → Check the next renewal date → Observe an unexpected date
root_cause: The next date is calculated by adding 30 days instead of a calendar month.
resolution: Use a calendar-aware 'add one month' function that clamps to the last day of the month.

resolution: Add padding-bottom equal to the footer height or use a sticky layout.

bug_description: Searching for 'café' returns no results although items exist. Reproduced by two colleagues.
screenshot_description: Search page showing 'No results for café'.
steps_to_reproduce: Open https://portal.demo-bank.vn/search → Type 'café' in the search box → Press Enter → Observe 'No results'
root_cause: The server decodes the query string as Latin-1 instead of UTF-8, so non-ASCII terms never match.
resolution: Decode the query as UTF-8 and add tests with non-ASCII characters.

resolution: Remove the duplicate listener and register events in one place.

bug_description: Bug: The home page crashes after the backend update (white screen). This happens every time.

Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLowerCase')
